children: New RADAR integrations bring OOH into the measurement systems marketers already use to make media investment decisions
) today announced the expansion of its
® data platform, connecting out-of-home (OOH) audience, exposure and delivery data with the omnichannel measurement solutions marketers already use.
The expansion includes an industry-first partnership with

, making Clear Channel the first OOH media company integrated into the solution, as well as integrations with TransUnion's Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) solutions. Together, these enhancements enable OOH exposure to flow into the same measurement frameworks used to evaluate CTV, social, search, digital video and audio, giving marketers greater visibility into OOH's contribution to campaign performance and media investment decisions.

"OOH has always been a powerful medium, but marketers need to be able to see its contribution within the same measurement frameworks they use across the rest of their media plans," said Dan Levi, EVP and Chief Marketing Officer at Clear Channel Outdoor. "By expanding RADAR through integrations with LiveRamp and TransUnion, we're making it easier for brands and agencies to understand how OOH contributes to campaign performance and make more informed decisions about where to invest their next media dollar."

As marketing budgets become increasingly guided by measurement, marketers need to understand how each channel contributes to campaign performance and where future investment can have the greatest impact. Historically, OOH has not always been represented in measurement models with the same level of audience and exposure detail available for other media channels. OOH is often excluded, grouped into "offline/other" categories, or represented primarily through a spend line, making it harder to accurately assess its contribution to marketing results.

Through LiveRamp's Cross-Media Intelligence, OOH exposure can be measured and deduplicated against other media exposures, giving marketers a unified view into which audiences are responding, interacting and converting across publishers and channels. Separately, TransUnion allows RADAR exposure data to be resolved against identity for MTA, while granular OOH delivery data feeds MMM. Together, these capabilities give brands and agencies greater visibility into OOH's contribution alongside other channels and customer touchpoints.

The integrations extend how marketers can measure OOH across the media plan. OOH exposure can be incorporated into LiveRamp's Cross-Media Intelligence alongside CTV, social, programmatic, audio and other media, and measured across the full media plan without double-counting exposures across channels. This provides marketers with a more complete view of campaign performance rather than requiring OOH to be evaluated separately. As the first OOH media company integrated into LiveRamp's Cross-Media Intelligence, Clear Channel is continuing to advance how OOH is incorporated into cross-media measurement.

"Cross-media measurement is most valuable when it gives marketers a complete picture of performance across their media mix," said Adam Solomon, VP, Product Management at LiveRamp. "By integrating Clear Channel Outdoor's data into Cross-Media Intelligence, we're helping marketers understand how OOH contributes alongside other channels and make more informed decisions about where to invest."

RADAR data also feeds TransUnion's MMM and MTA solutions, bringing OOH delivery and exposure data into both portfolio-level media modeling and customer-level attribution. Granular OOH delivery data provides a more meaningful input for evaluating OOH's contribution and informing future media allocation, while RADAR exposure data can be resolved against TransUnion's identity foundation, enabling OOH to be incorporated as a touchpoint within the customer journey.

"Marketers need measurement approaches that can connect media investment to business outcomes across the full customer journey," said Julie Clark, SVP of media and entertainment at TransUnion. "Bringing Clear Channel Outdoor's RADAR data into our MMM and MTA solutions gives marketers more meaningful inputs to assess OOH's contribution at both the portfolio and customer levels, helping inform future media allocation and optimization."
